rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: In the interview's second addition the chairman describes his feelings at his appointment as chairman (بتعيينه رئيساً لهيئة البيعة) and says that although a provision of the Law gives the chairmanship to the eldest member (أن يتولى رئاسة هيئة البيعة أكبر الأعضاء سناً), he took great pride in the King's trust in him.
